problem: Native-parent Custom XML lifecycle tests exposed four defects: failed OOXML insertion polluted staged items/source scope; valid out-of-order insertion failed publication; properties removal retained a stale part target; and legacy CFB Item/Properties validation rejected ordinary predefined/numeric XML references.
changes: Rollback a rejected OOXML item and defer source-precondition replacement until validation succeeds, preserving prior valid staging and its scope.

Normalize the staged item vector only when commit consumes it, using the same source-part/relationship-ID order as discovery. Staged ordinal selectors remain usable before commit, and full post-publication equality validation is retained.
Clear the properties part target when the cloned item no longer has properties XML, so properties-only removal produces the graph it declared.

Validate predefined and numeric XML references without changing retained lexical bytes. DTDs, undeclared references, references outside the root and XML-invalid characters remain refused. Known Properties grammar permits only whitespace text; opaque subtrees can retain valid referenced text.

Add six owning-format native-parent regressions and two shared XML-reference regressions, with a shared tracked test helper for the public CFB/store layers. Update DOC/XLS/XLSX matrices and scoped assertion bindings; no native fixture bytes or historical authoring inventory changed.

verification_scope.legacy_stores: Native DOC/document and macro-template plus XLS/workbook and macro-template parents start without MsoDataStore. Explicit additions use the shared typed store model and public CFB object transactions. Typed GUID/root/schema/XML checks, create/update/add/remove, exact no-op, duplicate/malformed refusal with prior staging retained, an exact one-item quota, stale patches, file reopen, forward replay and complete artifact inverse pass.
verification_scope.opaque_storage: An explicitly added sibling storage contains a pinned binary payload and an empty child with known CLSIDs, state bits and FILETIMEs. Creation retains original stream/directory metadata, and normal DOC paragraph edits or XLS Z121=42.5 insertion preserve the new owners and all unrelated stream bytes, including macros. Ordinary format inverses restore the complete input derivative.
verification_scope.cfb_publication_scope: The store patch owns only the typed store; CFB publication uses the public object owner. Object target keys are caller-supplied open policy, not artifact data. Byte patches are replayed with an unselected CFB view when topology changes, then reopened with target catalogs valid for the new directory. There is no new format-specific Custom XML package mutator or claim of native-app acceptance.
verification_scope.ooxml_lifecycle: Native Transitional XLSX, Strict XLSX and macro XLSM parents receive explicit custom data/properties parts with correct conformance relationships/namespaces. Payload/schema updates retain BOM/line endings/Unicode and opaque properties markup. Only the two selected custom members change during that update; no-op, stale replay, properties-only removal and final item cleanup preserve all original native parts and unrelated graph edges.
verification_scope.ooxml_atomicity: Duplicate GUID insertion against a different native source part returns the exact Invalid error and leaves both items and the captured precondition unchanged. B,A staging with an update at staged index zero publishes A,B catalog order with the update still on B. A payload exactly at the native-compatible byte ceiling succeeds; one byte more returns the exact typed PayloadBytes limit and preserves the staged value.
verification_scope.inverse_contract: CFB artifact patches restore complete bytes. OOXML inverse checks compare the complete effective relationship/content-type graph, every data-part byte, exact archive member keys and all unowned member bytes. Only the owned [Content_Types].xml and workbook relationship XML may normalize; compressed ZIP identity is not inferred.
verification_scope.xml_references: Shared tests cover all five predefined references, decimal/hexadecimal characters and exact UTF-8/UTF-16LE/UTF-16BE payload retention. Unknown entities, DTDs, null/surrogate/out-of-range characters and out-of-root references refuse. Properties preserve referenced opaque text while refusing non-whitespace core text; native CFB publication preserves those bytes after schema-reference edits.
verification_scope.limits: The Custom XML and opaque storage additions are library-authored derivatives of immutable native parents. Schemas/URIs remain inert. No XML mapping, application-specific transformation, schema validation, IRM promotion, external retrieval, macro execution, rendering or fresh Microsoft Office validation was performed.

specification_evidence.finding: MsoDataStore contains uniquely named sub-storages with Item and Properties streams; Item carries XML. The tests distinguish this structural/opaque storage contract from application XML semantics.

specification_evidence.reference: Tracked shared Custom XML snapshot/edit/package contracts
specification_evidence.finding: Source-scoped patches, catalog ordering, optional properties targets and retained payload bytes define the tested boundaries; host-supplied CFB target policies remain separate from artifact replacement.
